description: A double-height foyer and upper landing, captured at standing eye-level from the upper floor looking slightly down into the entryway below, with a normal-to-wide lens taking in both levels and the void between them. The staircase runs along the right side of the frame in warm stained walnut with open balusters and a dark metal railing. The floor below is laid in large-format pale stone tiles anchored by a deep navy and burgundy Persian rug with medallion pattern. Tall multi-pane windows on the right wall frame a twilight garden view, with deep indigo blue sky and illuminated foliage visible through the glass. Multiple clusters of warm glowing light cascade downward through the double-height void in overlapping rings, washing the staircase treads and walls in soft amber. The mood is dramatic and editorial with rich earth tones and jewel-accented textiles. Camera is at standing height on the upper landing, wide composition showing through the railing into the entry below.
